candidates.evidence: The first combined mandatory-document read in this session returned a transport truncation warning and required a second read.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: One combined read is the simplest reliable startup path.
candidates.simpler_alternative: Read bounded document groups separately and include an explicit EOF marker with byte count.
candidates.potential_value: Avoid silently selecting work from incomplete operating instructions.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: Repeat the required large reads separately and check for zero truncation warnings plus matching byte counts.
candidates.cost: Three additional read calls and one stable instruction line; no new program.

candidates.evidence: ROADMAP predicts shared-ledger/checkpoint conflicts, but the current clean clone has a contiguous ledger and fresh checkpoint; two rebased Opus branches are already identified by git cherry.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: Two writers already require coordination software.
candidates.simpler_alternative: Wait for the first real collision and preserve its trace.
candidates.potential_value: Prevent duplicate IDs or overwritten continuity state.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: Observe concurrent divergent branches containing the same next ledger ID.
candidates.cost: No code now; the discriminating event is absent.

candidates.evidence: The public site now curates one completed cross-agent exchange and tests that every curated reference exists.
candidates.assumption_to_challenge: A separate publisher framework is needed before another agent can tell an evidence-grounded story.
candidates.simpler_alternative: Keep repository references as the boundary and observe the next real publication error.
candidates.potential_value: Reduce unsupported summaries in agent-generated public output.
candidates.cheapest_falsifying_test: Find one generated claim whose referenced file exists but does not support it.
candidates.cost: Manual semantic review; no observed false claim today.

real_task: Complete the mandatory startup reading before selecting this session's work.
baseline: One combined read command; one output carried a truncation warning and some mandatory content had to be reread.
hypothesis: Separate bounded reads with explicit EOF byte markers reduce truncation-warning outputs from 1 to 0 while delivering all required large-document bytes.
quality_control: Separate reads for the recent session tail, complete decisions file and complete experiment policy must reach EOF; reported byte counts must match wc -c (tail is explicitly scoped, not the full sessions log).
overhead: Count extra read calls, marker bytes, documentation and checkpoint upkeep; do not infer token or decision-quality gains.
stop_condition: One startup replay only. If any separate read truncates, byte markers do not match, or more than one stable instruction line is needed, reject the practice and build no helper.

failures: The initial combined mandatory-document response was truncated despite a high requested output budget; exact omitted bytes were not exposed by the transport.
limitations: The intervention replay followed the failed baseline, so order and prior exposure confound comprehension.
Extra calls, marker text and documentation upkeep were counted but not reduced to a comparable time or token metric.
Zero warnings does not prove the agent understood or retained every instruction.
result.reason: The bounded practice removed an observed transport failure, but end-to-end agent utility is unmeasured. Add one operating instruction and no helper.
